hero.headline: Your next level starts here
hero.subheadline: This isn't about learning English. It's about preparing to prove your level. At NOVARA you'll find structured preparation for official Cambridge English exams, with content designed to help you move forward with confidence and reach your exam day fully prepared.

brandStatement.title: Fewer courses. More purpose.
brandStatement.body:
We're not here to fill a catalogue. We're here to offer training that actually makes sense.

At NOVARA, every course answers a specific goal. We choose content carefully, build a clear learning structure, and give you progress you can track at every stage.

Because learning isn't about collecting courses. It's about moving forward and going further.

howItWorks.title: Your path to the next level.

choose.title: Find your goal
choose.body: Explore our course selection and find the training that best fits your level, your needs and your goals.

learn.title: Learn with a clear structure
learn.body: Access lessons in different formats: text, audio and practical exercises. Move at your own pace and pick up your training whenever you need to.

assess.title: Put your knowledge to the test
assess.body: Check what you've learned through assessments designed to measure your knowledge. Meet the set criteria and prove you're ready.

certify.title: Get your certificate
certify.body: Once you pass the assessment, you'll receive your NOVARA certificate with a unique code and a public verification system.

testimonials.title: Student stories
testimonials.emptyState: We're still writing the first chapters. As soon as the first students finish their courses, their stories will have a home here.

faq.title: Everything you need to know before you start.

free.question: What kind of training does NOVARA offer?
free.answer: NOVARA offers structured digital training, with a particular focus on preparing for official Cambridge English exams. Our offering is designed to guide you from your current level to your academic goals.

payment.question: How do I purchase a course?
payment.answer: Select the course you're interested in, review its details, and complete checkout through our secure Stripe payment platform.

certificate.question: Are NOVARA certificates official?
certificate.answer: NOVARA issues its own completion certificates for students who meet each course's requirements. These certificates confirm the training completed on our platform, but they do not replace an official Cambridge English qualification or a certification issued by Cambridge English itself.

quality.question: How does NOVARA guarantee course quality?
quality.answer: Courses go through an editorial review process before publication. We work with structured content, defined learning objectives and clear assessment criteria.

mobile.question: Can I access NOVARA from my phone?
mobile.answer: Yes. NOVARA is designed to offer an accessible learning experience across devices, including computers, tablets and phones.

cta.title: Your next level won't reach itself.
cta.subtitle: Start with a decision. Continue with preparation, consistency and clear goals. At NOVARA you have the space to turn your academic goals into real progress.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of NOVARA. By creating an account or using the platform, you agree to what's described below.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
sections.body: NOVARA is an online academy offering free and paid courses, exams, verifiable certificates, and related educational content. These terms apply to anyone accessing the platform, with or without a registered account.

sections.heading: 2. User account
sections.body: To access certain features (enrolling in courses, obtaining certificates, purchasing premium courses) you need to create an account with a valid email. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity under your account.

sections.heading: 3. Free and premium courses
sections.body: Premium courses require payment of the amount shown for each course, processed securely through Stripe.

sections.heading: 4. Payments and refunds
sections.body: Access to a premium course is granted after verifying the proof of payment uploaded by the student. If a payment is rejected, the reason will be shown and you may upload a new proof. Refund requests are handled individually by contacting support.

sections.heading: 5. Certificates
sections.body: Certificates are generated automatically once a course's requirements are met (passing its final exam or completing 100% of the content, depending on the course) and can be verified publicly using the unique code and QR code included on each certificate.

sections.heading: 6. User conduct
sections.body: Sharing accounts, redistributing course content without authorization, or using the platform for fraudulent or unlawful purposes is not allowed. NOVARA may suspend or close accounts that violate these rules.

sections.heading: 7. Intellectual property
sections.body: Course content (videos, text, exercises, downloadable materials) is owned by NOVARA or its authors and protected by intellectual property rights. A personal, non-transferable license for use is granted — not for resale or redistribution.

sections.heading: 8. Changes
sections.body: These terms may be updated to reflect legal changes or changes in how the platform works. Material changes will be notified to registered users.

sections.heading: 9. Contact
sections.body: For any question about these terms, you can write to us from the Support page.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: At NOVARA we process your personal data solely to provide the educational service you signed up for. This policy explains what data we process, why, and what rights you have.

sections.heading: 1. What data we process
sections.body: Account data (name, email, encrypted password), profile data you choose to add (bio, country, avatar), academic progress data (courses, lessons, exams, certificates), and payment data limited to the proof you upload and your purchase request history — we never store card details.

sections.heading: 2. What we use it for
sections.body: To create and manage your account, give you access to the courses you enroll in, generate your certificates, send you necessary communications about your account or purchases, and improve the platform using aggregated internal statistics.

sections.heading: 3. Legal basis
sections.body: We process your data because it's necessary to perform the contract for the educational service (GDPR, art. 6.1.b), and, for optional communications, based on your consent.

sections.heading: 4. Who we share your data with
sections.body: We do not sell your data to third parties. We share strictly necessary data with providers that help us run the service: transactional email delivery, AI processing for the course-creation assistant (which only accesses course editorial content, never your personal data), and, if enabled, web analytics tools.

sections.heading: 5. How long we keep your data
sections.body: As long as your account is active. If you request account deletion, we delete or anonymize your personal data except information we must keep for legal obligations (e.g., invoices).

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
sections.body: You can access, rectify, delete, restrict the processing of, or object to the use of your data, and request data portability, by writing to us from the Support page. You also have the right to file a complaint with your local data protection authority.

sections.heading: 7. Security
sections.body: Passwords are stored encrypted, connections use HTTPS, and access to sensitive data is restricted by roles within the platform.

sections.heading: 8. Minors
sections.body: NOVARA is not directed at children under 16. If we become aware of an account created by a minor without guardian consent, we will proceed to delete it.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: We use cookies and similar technologies to make the platform work correctly and, if enabled, to better understand how it's used.

sections.heading: 1. Technical cookies (always active)
sections.body: Necessary for basic operation: keeping you signed in, remembering your preferred language and theme, and protecting the platform against improper access. Without them, NOVARA couldn't function.

sections.heading: 2. Referral cookie
sections.body: If you arrive at NOVARA through an affiliate's link, we store their code in a cookie for 30 days so we can correctly attribute the commission if you sign up and purchase a course. It's used for no other purpose.

sections.heading: 3. Analytics cookies (optional)
sections.body: If enabled by the NOVARA team from settings, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Microsoft Clarity, or Plausible may be used to understand, in aggregate, how the platform is used. You can ask support whether they're currently active.

sections.heading: 4. Managing cookies
sections.body: You can delete or block cookies from your browser settings. Note that blocking technical cookies may prevent you from signing in or keeping your preferences.
